Rae (People Ops): Heads-up: Aisha's birthday is Friday 2026-07-23. Quick brainstorm: mini pinata at 3pm + cupcakes, or just cupcakes and a card? thoughts :tada:
Aisha: I'm low-key — cupcakes sound perfect! also no nuts pls (allergy).
Tom: Cupcakes + card. pinata might be messy in the open seating area.
Ben: If we do cupcakes, can someone get vegan/gluten-free labeled options? happy to pick up.
Sofia: Also remote that day but can join for a 5-min camera cameo at 3:05 if you do a group hi.
Marta: I can order from the bakery that does vegan cupcakes. price ~ $28 for 12.
Ethan: +1 to skip pinata. also maybe a tiny desk plant instead? lasts longer.
hr-bot: Policy reminder: no confetti or glitter decorations in shared seating. Avoid anything that could trigger sprinklers.
Ivy: I'm in for the gift pool. How much should we collect?
Rae (People Ops): Plan: cupcakes (including vegan/GF) + small desk plant + e-card. Suggested contribution $7. I'll post payment link and calendar invite for 2:55-3:10 PM.
Ivy: Sent $7 (https://pay.example/giftpool/aisha).
Aisha: You all are so thoughtful 9700, thank you! no singing required :blush:
Rae (People Ops): Calendar invite "Aisha - cupcakes & hi" created for Fri 2:55-3:10. Cake table will have allergen labels. If you're remote, drop in at 3:05 for a quick hello.
Ben: RSVP: I'll bring napkins and forks.
Marta: Ordering vegan batch now. ETA 2:40 for setup.
Tom: I'll sign the card before 2:50.
Rae (People Ops): Thanks team  will update if anything changes.
